mentions.name: Quillium
mentions.description: This is a nonlinear writing editor that tracks all versions of different words, paragraphs, sentences, and drafts, so writers no longer juggle files like Final_FINAL_v3_essay.docx. The author polished it up to dogfood it for their college applications.
mentions.problem: Manually managing multiple versions of writing leads to cluttered, confusingly named files like Final_FINAL_v3_essay.docx.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I was able to polish up Quillium (https://quillium.bryanhu.com) so I can dogfood it for my college applications.

It's a nonlinear writing editor, so I can keep track of all the versions of different words, paragraphs, sentences, or drafts. No more Final_FINAL_v3_essay.docx
mentions.author: thatxliner
